controls.assessmentScope: Reported fiscal 2025 total revenue, reporting years and currency units only. Other claims in the multi-claim target require separate evidence.
controls.rationale: The revenue table directly permits comparison of the target revenue estimate. Digital Media ARR is optional context and is not required to verify total revenue.

controls.assessmentScope: Historical Digital Media ARR and segment revenue baseline.
controls.rationale: A historical baseline informs the forecast but cannot verify FY2027 outcomes or AI attach-rate assumptions.

controls.assessmentScope: Firefly integration with Creative Cloud applications.
controls.rationale: The passage establishes cross-application compatibility, not the specific Premiere assistant sorting and marker features asserted.

controls.assessmentScope: Firefly commercial indemnification and its alleged competitive effect.
controls.rationale: General contractual applicability does not establish Firefly indemnification or a deployment moat. No adequate positive reference has been adjudicated in this control.

controls.assessmentScope: Percentages in a third-party network-importance survey.
controls.rationale: An accelerated-computing platform description cannot corroborate survey percentages or respondent identity.

controls.assessmentScope: Integration effects on deployment complexity, time to value and switching costs.
controls.rationale: Product-transition inventory and adoption risks are not direct evidence of customer switching cost or time-to-value effects.

controls.assessmentScope: An integrated platform spanning GPUs, CPUs, DPUs, networking and software.
controls.rationale: The primary paragraph directly describes the platform and processing-unit integration. It does not independently verify every named branded component in the target.

controls.assessmentScope: License transfer restrictions as a possible source of switching constraints.
controls.rationale: The license grant is relevant context, but does not establish harmful lock-in or quantify switching costs.

controls.assessmentScope: Quarterly revenue and year-over-year growth for the reported July 2026 quarter.
controls.rationale: The quarterly table contains both reporting dates, units and comparative revenue. Matching values alone must not substitute for period alignment.

equivalentEvidenceSets.rationale: The disaggregation table retains the July 31 2026 and 2025 quarter headings, amounts in thousands, and total revenue 1,546,793 and 1,144,969. It answers the same quarterly revenue comparison, not future guidance.

controls.assessmentScope: Current agent and platform capabilities relevant to a proposed future architecture.
controls.rationale: Existing Snowflake Intelligence and Postgres features provide background, not proof that clients will become the future workplace described.

controls.assessmentScope: Public-cloud deployment and the storage, compute and services architecture.
controls.rationale: The primary paragraph directly describes public-cloud deployment and the three integrated architecture layers.

controls.assessmentScope: Relative maturity across five proposed System of Intelligence layers.
controls.rationale: The shared-disk/shared-nothing architecture paragraph does not verify this maturity assessment or its listed governance and agent products.

controls.assessmentScope: Ending ARR, its definition, reporting date and comparative growth.
controls.rationale: The ARR definition and dated table directly permit comparison of the numeric target. Four consecutive quarters of acceleration require additional periods.

controls.assessmentScope: Timing of reaching a USD 10 billion ARR target by FY2031.
controls.rationale: Historical profitability and accumulated deficit do not corroborate an ARR target date or its expected acceleration.

controls.assessmentScope: The July 19 update causing crashes on Windows systems.
controls.rationale: The incident disclosure directly identifies the update, affected systems and date. It does not establish every broader consequence in other sources.

controls.assessmentScope: Consolidation increasing AI authority and operational blast radius.
controls.rationale: File-upload and crash-report processing terms do not establish delegated AI authority or the asserted blast-radius relationship.

method: Assistant-adjudicated regression references, not independent human ground truth. Exact-span recall remains a separate diagnostic.
